notes: v1.3.0 polish release. New: Find by text - on click/type/select/checkbox/clear/verify steps you can now target one of several look-alike items (open service orders, batches, rows) by matching a value from your data, with 7 match modes. The step then acts on an element inside the matched item; if zero or more than one match, the row fails rather than guessing. Setup and teardown flows now pause in step mode just like main steps. Toolbar Run button becomes Open last log when idle. Token brace typos like {{Name} are now flagged before a run. Bigger UI text. Fixes: text in step fields is now selectable (drag only grabs the handle), verification panel no longer flickers between steps, stop-then-restart is hardened with a safety timer and clearer logging, and the dead Pause button was removed.
